info.title: HOMI
info.description: HOMI API v1. Every response uses the `{success, data, meta?}` envelope; errors use `{success: false, message, code, errors?}` (ADR-0007, ADR-0017); every answer of a source method carries `meta.source` (`stub`, `legacy` or `native`), and cursor lists `meta.next_cursor` (docs/api/README.md). Authentication: Sanctum bearer tokens (ADR-0003). Collector intake: see docs/api/intake.md.

get.summary: `GET /favorites`: previews, newest first, each with `favorite: true`. Scenario `empty`

put.summary: `PUT /favorites/{number}`: idempotent; the listing must exist (`404`), or be checkable (`503`)

delete.summary: `DELETE /favorites/{number}`: idempotent, never `404` for a listing that was not a favourite

get.summary: `GET /hidden`: hidden listings, newest first, and blocked authors

delete.summary: `DELETE /hidden`: clears hidden listings and blocked authors of the caller
`DELETE /hidden/authors/{id}`: removes one blocked author by entry id

get.summary: `GET /history`: previews by last view, newest first, each with `viewed: true`. Scenario `empty`

`GET /listings`: one page of previews; `meta.next_cursor` null ends the list. A page may hold fewer than
`limit` items; the client de-duplicates by `number`

`GET /listings/{number}`: the full card, or the preview with `preview=1`. A merged duplicate answers with the
surviving number; an unknown or removed number is `404 not_found`. No answer carries the author's number
Show a media file with its public or temporary URLs

delete.description:
The original, its variants and the record go with the last reference; while another owner
holds the file it stays readable for them.
delete.summary: Delete the caller's reference to a media file

post.description:
Stores the original under a content-addressed key and queues WebP variants; uploading the
same bytes again returns the existing media file and makes the caller one of its owners.

post.summary: Create a presigned PUT URL on the tmp disk
Register an object uploaded through a presigned URL as a media file

get.summary: `GET /radars`: the radars in creation order; `include=previews` adds each radar's preview

post.summary:
`POST /radars`: creates a radar, or answers the active radar with the same filters (`existing`, `200`) or
switches on a paused one (`reactivated`, `200`). The same filters ignore `posted_days` and the order of keys
and lists (BR-APP-012)

filters.description: The filters object of WP-12; any subset of its 25 keys, normalised for a radar.

delete.summary: `DELETE /radars/{id}`: works while the switch is off, so nothing can be left behind

filters.description: The filters object of WP-12; any subset of its 25 keys, normalised for a radar.

patch.summary: `PATCH /radars/{id}`: switches on (with `starter`), pauses (with `ask_found`), changes the mode or unhides
The stub validates and answers the fixture with the sent keys overlaid; nothing is stored

message.description: Human-readable summary; not for program logic.

Currency.description: The display currencies of the product. Prices in the reference data are whole USD whatever the user's currency.
Currency.title: Currency

Deal.description: The three deals of the product: long-term rent, daily rent, sale. Keys of every per-deal object of `/api/v1`.
Deal.title: Deal

ListingSort.description: The order of `GET /listings` (WP-12, BR-APP-023). `new` is the default.
ListingSort.title: ListingSort

Locale.description: The languages of `/api/v1` (CF-006: `uz` is the only Uzbek code on this surface; `uz_Latn` lives only inside the legacy driver).
Locale.title: Locale

Market.description: New building or secondary market (`market` filter of a sale, BR-API-029).
Market.title: Market

OwnerFilter.description: The `owner` filter (BR-API-035): everything, without explicit realtors, or only explicit owners.
OwnerFilter.title: OwnerFilter

PatchRadarRequest.description:
`PATCH /radars/{id}` (WP-13): exactly one known change — `active` (switch on or pause), `mode` or `unhide: true`.
No key, several keys or an unknown key is `422` (`08` API-021).
PatchRadarRequest.title: PatchRadarRequest

PriceKind.description: The label kind of a price (BR-API-156): a down payment of an instalment sale, or the price of a business with its premises rented out (since legacy release `index-Dbpp463V.js`). Any other legacy value becomes null (Q-API-065).
PriceKind.title: PriceKind

PropertyType.description: What a listing offers (`types[]` of the filters, `type` of a listing; WP-12, BR-API-028).
PropertyType.title: PropertyType

RadarMode.description: How a radar sends (WP-13): each listing at once, or a digest at the user's digest hours.
RadarMode.title: RadarMode

RadarMutationKind.description: What `POST /radars` or `PUT /radars/{id}` did (WP-13): a new radar, an active radar with the same filters already existed (nothing written; the client shows "already on"), a paused one was switched on, or the filters changed.
RadarMutationKind.title: RadarMutationKind

key.description: Keys are issued by POST /media/presign as uploads/{owner_type}/{owner_id}/{ulid}.{ext}.

RelaxRadarRequest.description:
`POST /radars/{id}/relax` (WP-13): `code` of one of the options the radar offered; the controller checks it
against the radar's options (`422` on `code` otherwise).
RelaxRadarRequest.title: RelaxRadarRequest

SourceDriver.description: Which implementation of a capability answered (ADR-0017): fixtures, the legacy service, or HOMI's own code. Written to every `/api/v1` answer as `meta.source`; the client's "demo data" marker reads `stub`.
SourceDriver.title: SourceDriver

StoreEventRequest.description:
`POST /events` (WP-11): `{name, props?}`. A `422` only for a missing or non-string `name` or a `props` that is not an
object. An unknown name, a name outside the pattern or unknown properties are accepted and not stored (WP-47 stores
the catalogue). The raw body is capped at 8 KB before anything else: over it, `413 payload_too_large`.
StoreEventRequest.title: StoreEventRequest

StoreFoundAnswerRequest.description:
`POST /surveys/found` (WP-13, API-032): the answer to «Нашли жильё?» and what asked it. The legacy answer `kvadro`
is `homi` (brand, DEC-40). Extra keys are ignored.
StoreFoundAnswerRequest.title: StoreFoundAnswerRequest

StoreFoundWhereRequest.description: `POST /surveys/found/where` (WP-13, API-033): where the home was found. Extra keys are ignored.
StoreFoundWhereRequest.title: StoreFoundWhereRequest

file.description: Content validation (MIME sniffing, dimensions) happens in HashedUploader.

StoreRadarRequest.description:
`POST /radars` (WP-13): the filters and `entry`, where the radar was turned on, kept for statistics (BR-API-086):
the filters sheet, the new-radar sheet, the few-results note, the follow nudge, the feed card and the return banner.
StoreRadarRequest.title: StoreRadarRequest

StoreReportRequest.description:
`POST /listings/{number}/reports` (WP-13, API-016): `reason`, and `detail` only with `wrong_data` (the third step
of the report sheet, BR-API-101). `wrong_data` without a detail is accepted for older bundles; a null detail counts
as absent.
StoreReportRequest.title: StoreReportRequest

TelegramSignInRequest.description: `POST /auth/telegram`: the raw `initData` query string of the Mini App launch, at most 4 096 bytes.
TelegramSignInRequest.title: TelegramSignInRequest

Tenant.description: Who the long rent is for (`tenant` filter, BR-API-029).
Tenant.title: Tenant

Theme.description: The colour theme a user chose; `auto` follows Telegram.
Theme.title: Theme

UpdateSettingsRequest.description:
`PATCH /settings` (WP-11): any subset of the six writable keys; unknown keys are ignored. A city must be one of
`GET /reference` (same driver, same scenario); quiet and digest hours must equal one of the presets of
`config/settings.php`.
UpdateSettingsRequest.title: UpdateSettingsRequest
